public.initialization: Fresh LoRA r8/a16/dropout.05 on original pinned SEA-LION base, same initialization policy as earlier small public run; not continuing from already-task-trained model.
public.selection: Use final full-pass checkpoint for task phase so it has seen all usable pairs. Public validation monitors every10000 but does not revert to an earlier checkpoint.
public.checkpoint: Atomic trusted local .pt of LoRA weights, optimizer, RNG, progress and report every4000 examples, only at optimizer boundaries; restart same script to resume interrupted public pass.

task.selection: Minimum original100 target equal-style CE among trained epochs1+. Same task dataset/recipe as corrected subset-public run356064, public size+compute are intervention.

evaluation.scope: Reused development, not independent human gold or locked test. Compare English usefulness and LOCAL fidelity/naturalness against356064; do not mix this intervention into fidelity renderer pilot.
limitations: Pattern filters are not independent semantic quality or full de-identification guarantees.
CoSEM source was historically mT5-relatedness filtered before this experiment.
Public source validation groups are not trained; product locked test unread; raw public text stays ignored/private.

public_manifest.scope: All unique usable contextual pairs from available historically-cleaned CoSEM and DailyDialog source exports. No4000 sample limits, per-chat caps, response caps or marker quota. Not the complete unfiltered published CoSEM corpus.
public_manifest.policy: Same conservative original filters and DIALOGUE tag; whole group/pair holdouts and project pairs excluded; six previous quarantine IDs excluded. Original public wording retained, DailyDialog punctuation detokenized.400 validation pairs identical to pilot.
